Calibrate and compare mortality forecasting models

Source: R/workflow.R
calibrate.Rd

Runs cross-validated calibration for Tucker3 (CoDa and Direct) and optionally other models (Lee-Carter, FDM, StMoMo, ARIMA, ETS, RWD), then compares all on a holdout test set and builds an ensemble.

Usage

calibrate(
  data,
  models = c("tucker3_coda", "tucker3_direct", "lee_carter", "fdm", "ets", "arima",
    "rwd"),
  holdout_years = NULL,
  holdout_frac = 0.2,
  ensemble = TRUE,
  ensemble_top_k = 3L,
  rank_selection = c("cv", "bic", "aic"),
  cv_metric = c("mase", "mase_combined", "mase_trend"),
  config = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A mort_data object. If not yet smoothed, smoothing is applied automatically.

models

Character vector of models to evaluate. Available: "tucker3_coda", "tucker3_direct", "lee_carter", "fdm", "stmomo", "arima", "ets", "rwd".

holdout_years

Integer vector of years for holdout test. If NULL, the last holdout_frac of years is used.

holdout_frac

Fraction of years for holdout (default 0.2). Ignored if holdout_years is provided.

ensemble

Logical; build an inverse-MASE ensemble? (default TRUE)

ensemble_top_k

Maximum number of models in the ensemble.

rank_selection

Character; rank selection strategy for Tucker3 models. "cv" (default) uses rolling-origin cross-validation, "bic" or "aic" selects ranks via information criteria (faster). Passed to calibrate_tucker3().

cv_metric

Character; scoring metric for cross-validation. "mase" (default) uses cell-level MASE, "mase_combined" uses 0.7 * cell + 0.3 * trend MASE, "mase_trend" uses trend MASE only. Applied to all models during calibration.

config

Optional mort_config for advanced settings (smoothing method, COVID years, etc.).

...

Additional arguments passed to calibration functions.

Value

A mort_calibration object.
